title: Planet Tweaks V3.2.4 NOVA TITAN - Hone Mouse Studio & Zero Mojibake Esports Suite
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.2.4 NOVA TITAN: (1) Complete Zero-Mojibake UI sweep eliminating all corrupt character artifacts across Debloat, Pro Packs, and Tools. (2) Hone Peripherals & Live Mouse Telemetry Studio: Live wireless receiver header, real-time Hz polling selector (125, 250, 500, 1000), DPI stages selector, and interactive debounce click test. (3) Prominent Discord Rich Presence Hero Card placed at top of Settings with live toggle and presence preview. (4) ExitLag-Style Auto-Ping DNS Benchmark measuring live ICMP latency on open with 1-click lowest ping apply. (5) Esports Mic Isolation & De-Bleed in Windows Tools and Headphone Studio eliminating game/music leakage into Discord/chat. (6) Compact modern sub-tabs in Random tab eliminating vertical scrolling. (7) Verified 100% Pro Pack alignment across Max FPS, Peterbot, Clix, and Mero packs.
